summary: Clearwater NF lookout built in 1934. Sources disagree on whether it was abandoned and gone by 1964 or burned in 1954. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Gone by 1964 according to two lookout-history pages; the Forest Service list says it burned in 1954.

events.note: 20-foot L-4 tower per firelookout.com and idahofirelookouts.com; the Forest Service list says L-4 cabin
Forest Service Clearwater list says burned in 1954; the other two pages say abandoned in the 1950s

evidence.supports: 1934 20-foot L-4 tower on the northeast point; abandoned in the 1950s; gone by 1964
evidence.quote: 1934: 20' L-4 tower atop northeast point. Abandoned 1950s. Gone by 1964.

evidence.supports: Forest Service list describes an L-4 cabin
Forest Service list says it burned in 1954
Idaho list marks the tower as gone
no source describes the site today; the page's last entry is gone by 1964
1934 20-foot L-4 tower on the northeast point
same-year L-4 cabin entry for Boundary Peak, burned in 1954

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and idahofirelookouts.com describe a 20-foot L-4 tower; the Forest Service Clearwater list says L-4 cabin. Both are reported; the record kind 'tower' is kept.
Forest Service list: burned in 1954. firelookout.com and idahofirelookouts.com: abandoned in the 1950s, gone by 1964. The sources read do not reconcile these, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: The build year (1934) and location agree across all sources. The fate does not: the Forest Service list says burned in 1954 while the two lookout-history pages say abandoned in the 1950s and gone by 1964. Two searches found no further record. Record elevation_m is null while the sources give 5,243 ft (about 1,598 m); suggest filling it. Do not confuse with the Kootenai Boundary Peak at 47.81440, -116.32418, which is a different lookout. Status gone matches the record, so no correction is proposed.
